description: This file defines the ProspectsJjwg_MapsLogicHook class, which implements logic hooks related to geocoding information updates for prospect records within the SuiteCRM module. It manages the invocation of geocoding functions after save events, contingent on configuration settings.

classes.name: ProspectsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A class that manages logic hooks for prospect geocoding updates, contingent on configuration settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the jjwg_Maps property with module info.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Hook method called before saving a prospect; updates geocode info if enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Hook method called after saving a prospect; updates related meetings' geocode info if enabled.
